mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COLLECT (COLLECT_ID, BILL_ID, ORDER_ID, CUST_ID, COLLECT_DT, COLLECT_AMT, COLLECT_METHOD, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{collectId}, #{billId}, #{orderId}, #{custId}, #{collectDt}, #{collectAmt}, #{collectMethod}, #{regUserId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT B.TOTAL_AMT - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(L.COLLECT_AMT) FROM TB_COLLECT L WHERE L.BILL_ID = B.BILL_ID), 0) FROM TB_BILL B WHERE B.BILL_ID = #{billId}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(B.TOTAL_AMT), 0) - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(L.COLLECT_AMT) FROM TB_COLLECT L WHERE L.CUST_ID = #{custId}), 0) FROM TB_BILL B WHERE B.CUST_ID = #{custId} AND B.ISSUE_STATUS = '10'
